definitionZh: *selection CSS伪元素对用户突出显示的文档部分应用样式(例如点击和拖动鼠标横跨文本).
sourceDefinition: The ::selection CSS pseudo-element applies styles to the part of a document that has been highlighted by the user (such as clicking and dragging the mouse across text).
